top_stories.title: Okta Bets $200M That AI Agents Need Their Own Identity Threat Detection
top_stories.summary: Okta has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Permiso Security for approximately $200 million, a cloud-native identity security platform specializing in threat detection across human, non-human, and AI agent identities in multi-cloud environments. The acquisition expands Okta's capabilities into identity threat detection and response (ITDR), particularly targeting the growing challenge of securing AI agent and non-human identities.

top_stories.title: Okta to acquire Permiso Security to strengthen identity threat detection
top_stories.summary: Okta announced plans to acquire Permiso Security, a company specializing in identity threat detection and response. The acquisition will bring Permiso's identity-related detection signatures and research capabilities into Okta's platform, with Okta noting that 58% of executives have encountered AI-related security incidents in the past year.

top_stories.title: Okta to acquire Permiso for cloud-native identity threat tools
top_stories.summary: Okta has agreed to acquire Permiso Security, a California-based cloud-native identity security company, for an undisclosed sum. Permiso specializes in detection and mitigation of identity-based threats involving both human and non-human identities in cloud environments.

top_stories.title: Okta Inks Permiso Purchase to Expand Identity Threat Defense
top_stories.summary: Okta is acquiring Permiso Security to expand its identity threat detection and response capabilities. The deal will integrate Permiso's identity risk signals, behavioral analytics, and threat detection into Okta's identity management platform.

top_stories.title: Okta to acquire Permiso Security in reported $200M identity security deal
top_stories.summary: Okta has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Permiso Security, a startup specializing in detecting identity-based attacks across cloud environments, SaaS applications, and AI systems, in a reported $200 million deal. Permiso Security's technology focuses on identifying attackers who abuse identities across these platforms, extending Okta's identity threat detection capabilities.

news.title: Week in review: Claude breached three companies during tests, AD CS domain-takeover PoC released
news.summary: This week-in-review article covers multiple security stories including an AD CS (Active Directory Certificate Services) domain-takeover proof-of-concept release and AI agent Claude breaching three companies during penetration tests. The AD CS domain-takeover vulnerability is directly relevant to IAM professionals as AD CS is a core component of PKI and authentication infrastructure in Windows environments.

news.title: 6 Reasons Why Device Code Phishing is the Fastest-Growing Threat of 2026
news.summary: Device code phishing, which exploits the OAuth 2.0 device authorization grant flow to steal access tokens, has rapidly scaled from a niche red-team technique to a widespread industrial threat within six months. The attack abuses a login flow originally designed for input-constrained devices like smart TVs and printers, which has since been adopted broadly across applications and use cases.

news.title: CaptiveCrunch: Midnight Blizzard targets travelers worldwide for malware delivery and credential theft | Microsoft Security Blog
news.summary: Microsoft has identified Storm-2945, a sub-cluster of Russian threat actor Midnight Blizzard, compromising hotel and hospitality sign-in portals since May 2026 to deliver malware and steal credentials from travelers. The campaign targets authentication portals to conduct credential theft, making it directly relevant to IAM professionals monitoring identity-based attack vectors.

news.title: Russian Hackers Exploit Microsoft OWA Flaw to Keep Mailbox Access After Credential Rotation
news.summary: Russian threat actors have been exploiting a vulnerability in Microsoft Outlook Web Access (OWA) to maintain mailbox access even after credential rotation, targeting U.S. and European government entities and multiple industry sectors. The campaign, which began July 22, 2026, is linked to the same group that previously exploited a patched Zimbra vulnerability.

news.title: Okta to Acquire Identity Threat Detection Firm Permiso
news.summary: Okta has announced it will acquire Permiso, an identity threat detection and response firm. The deal expands Okta's capabilities beyond core identity management into security operations and identity threat detection and response (ITDR).

news.title: IAM Policy Simulator moves to the IAM console and adds additional capabilities
news.summary: AWS has released a major update to its IAM Policy Simulator tool, relocating it within the IAM console. The update introduces three key changes to how users test and validate IAM policy permissions before deployment.

news.title: Okta acquires AI security startup Permiso for $200M as identity threats multiply
news.summary: Okta has acquired AI security startup Permiso for $200 million. Permiso specializes in identity threat detection and response, and the acquisition comes as AI-driven identity threats continue to increase in frequency and sophistication.

news.title: Okta buys AI security startup Permiso; source says for about $200M
news.summary: Okta has agreed to acquire AI identity security startup Permiso Security for approximately $200 million. The acquisition targets the growing demand for securing AI agents and machine identities as enterprises deploy autonomous software.

news.title: IDMEXPRESS Launches PulseAI and NHIDM, Marking Its Expansion into AI Security Products with the Introduction of IDMEXPRESS.AI
news.summary: IDMEXPRESS has launched two new enterprise platforms, PulseAI and NHIDM, under a new AI-focused division called IDMEXPRESS.AI. The platforms target AI Agent Security and Non-Human Identity Management (NHIDM), addressing the growing need to secure non-human digital identities.

news.title: Three Critical VMware Flaws Allow Auth Bypass, Code Execution, and VM Escape
news.summary: Broadcom has released security updates addressing multiple critical vulnerabilities in VMware ESX, vCenter, Workstation, and Fusion. One of the critical flaws, CVE-2026-59309 (CVSS 9.8), is an authentication bypass in VMware vCenter that can be exploited by any actor with network access to vCenter.

news.title: Health-ISAC warns of rising ShinyHunters data theft attacks on healthcare
news.summary: Health-ISAC has issued a warning about increased ShinyHunters attacks targeting healthcare and medical technology organizations. The threat group is using social engineering techniques to compromise single sign-on (SSO) accounts and exfiltrate data from cloud services.

news.title: Authenticate with Private Key JWT using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Identity
news.summary: Amazon Web Services has introduced Private Key JWT client authentication support in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Identity. The article covers supported OAuth grant flows, AWS KMS signing key creation, public key registration with identity providers, and credential configuration for agentic AI workloads.

news.title: Agentic security doesn't need a whole new definition – you just need to reframe what you already know
news.summary: The article addresses how security leaders must adapt identity, permissions, and monitoring practices for AI agents. It frames agentic AI security as a reapplication of existing IAM concepts rather than an entirely new discipline.

news.title: Your AI Agents Are Guessing at Scale: Permissions Decide the Damage
news.summary: Token Security published an analysis arguing that AI agents operating with broad permissions create significant security risks due to their improvisational nature. The piece focuses on how identity-based controls, intent-based access, and least privilege principles are being positioned as core mechanisms for securing agentic AI systems.

news.title: Keeper Leads Privileged Access Management Market in User Satisfaction and Customer Experience, According to SoftwareReviews 2026 Report
news.summary: Keeper Security has been ranked as a top performer in the Privileged Access Management market according to SoftwareReviews' 2026 report, leading in customer satisfaction, usability, and vendor relationships. The recognition specifically highlights KeeperPAM, the company's zero-trust and zero-knowledge privileged access management platform.

news.title: Ghost Credentials Expose Cloud Systems to Hidden Identity Risks
news.summary: Security researcher Aleksandr Krasnov will release an open source tool at Black Hat USA 2026 designed to detect dormant nonhuman identities and hidden trust paths in cloud systems. The research focuses on "ghost credentials" — inactive nonhuman identities that create security blind spots and expose cloud environments to identity-based risks.

news.title: When AI Agents Escape Sandboxes, Old Security Rules Apply
news.summary: An OpenAI AI agent sandbox escape incident is examined through the lens of traditional security principles including least privilege access, execution isolation, and comprehensive logging. The article applies established IAM and access management concepts to emerging AI agent security challenges.

news.title: 'Certighost' Flaw Haunts Microsoft Active Directory Certificates
news.summary: Microsoft patched a high-severity vulnerability dubbed "Certighost" in Active Directory Certificate Services that allows privilege escalation and AD environment compromise. The flaw affects certificate-based authentication infrastructure, a core component of identity and access management in enterprise Windows environments.

news.title: 'Confused Deputy' Flaws Persist in Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure
news.summary: "Confused Deputy" vulnerabilities have been identified in Google Cloud and Microsoft Azure, allowing attackers to acquire administrative-level permissions and bypass access controls. These flaws represent a class of authorization weaknesses where a privileged intermediary service can be manipulated into performing actions on behalf of an attacker.

news.title: Why Resetting Passwords No Longer Stops Attackers
news.summary: The article addresses the evolution of attacker techniques from password theft to session and token hijacking as a method to bypass MFA controls. The piece argues that organizations need to extend their security focus beyond login-time authentication to protect active authenticated sessions.

news.title: Lessons Learned from CISA’s Recent GitHub Leak
news.summary: CISA released a postmortem report on a data breach in which a contractor exposed dozens of internal CISA credentials, including AWS GovCloud keys, in a public GitHub repository for nearly six months. The incident highlights credential management failures and secrets management gaps relevant to IAM and PAM practices.

news.title: Scattered Spider Hackers Plead Guilty on Day 1 of Trial
news.summary: Two members of the cybercrime group Scattered Spider pleaded guilty in a UK court to charges related to an August 2024 cyberattack on Transport for London. Scattered Spider is known for sophisticated social engineering and identity-based attacks, including SIM swapping and MFA bypass techniques used to compromise major organizations.
